01

Direction & Symbol

Long or short, on one of 12 tracked pairs. Falcon only signals futures pairs with enough liquidity for clean institutional footprints — no obscure low-volume coins.

02

Entry — a single price, not a zone

One exact limit order price. Not "buy somewhere around here." The signal starts as PENDING and you get a popup the moment price actually fills it.

03

Stop Loss — your hard exit

Placed at the actual structural level that invalidates the setup — not an arbitrary percentage. If price reaches it, the trade is over. No averaging down, no "just a bit more room."

04

Take Profit — one target, fixed

A single TP at minimum 1:3 reward-to-risk. One target means one decision: it hits, or it doesn't. No second-guessing whether to take partial profit early.

05

Risk : Reward ratio

Shown plainly so you know exactly what you're risking to win. Every signal that doesn't clear 1:3 minimum is rejected before it's ever sent.

06

Confidence score

A 0–100% score from the live confluence count — trend alignment, structure quality, entry precision, and market conditions. Signals only fire at ≥80%.

07

Dynamic Leverage

Calculated per trade so that hitting the stop always costs the same 2% of account, regardless of how tight or wide the stop is. Tighter stop → higher leverage. Wider stop → lower leverage. The math is fixed, the leverage adapts to it — never the other way around.

08

Setup description

A short tag of the actual SMC pattern that triggered the signal — liquidity sweep, break of structure, order block, fair value gap. You can see exactly what the bot reacted to, not a black box.

09

Session & estimated duration

Falcon only signals during London, New York, and the London/NY overlap — the hours with genuine institutional volume. Estimated duration tells you roughly how long to expect the trade to play out.

RISK ENGINE

The math behind every leverage number

Dynamic leverage isn't a gimmick — it's a formula that keeps every loss the same size in account terms, no matter the setup.

ParameterValueWhat it means
Risk per trade2.0% fixedEvery signal risks the same fraction of your account, regardless of asset or leverage
Max daily risk12.0%Hard ceiling on cumulative exposure across all open signals in a day
Min risk:reward1 : 3No signal fires below this — the floor, not the average
Min confidence≥ 80%Confluence-scored threshold below which a setup is discarded
Leverage range1x – 100xAuto-calculated as risk% ÷ stop-loss% — tight stop, higher leverage; wide stop, lower leverage
Pending expiry5 hoursUnfilled limit orders cancel automatically — never counted as a win or loss
Active sessionsLondon / NY / Overlap07:00–21:00 UTC — the windows with real institutional volume
Signal cooldown2h per symbol / 45m globalPrevents signal clustering and overtrading on a single move

BEFORE YOU JOIN ANYTHING

There is no bot, strategy, or trader on Earth with a 100% win rate. Anyone promising that is selling a story, not a strategy.

The crypto market doesn't reward certainty — it rewards consistency. A real edge looks like more wins than losses over a large enough sample, executed with the same discipline every single time, with risk small enough that any one loss is just noise.

That's the entire premise behind Falcon: not a promise of profit, but a system that removes emotion, fixes risk at 2% per trade, and only acts when enough confluences line up. Some signals will lose. That's not a flaw in the system — it's what an honest 70–85% win rate actually looks like in practice.

⚠️

DYOR — Do Your Own Research. Falcon Crypto Signals is an educational and analytical tool, not financial advice. Trading crypto futures carries real risk of loss, including loss greater than your initial margin when using leverage. Past performance — ours or anyone's — never guarantees future results. Only trade with capital you can afford to lose, and size every position deliberately.

QUESTIONS

Before you ask

Do you guarantee profits?+
No, and anyone who does is misleading you. Falcon provides well-analysed, rule-based signals with fixed risk management. Markets move, losses happen, and you should only ever trade with money you can afford to lose.
How many signals will I get per day?+
A minimum of 4 and a maximum of 6–8 per day across 12 pairs, depending on how many setups actually meet the confluence and confidence thresholds. Falcon never fires a signal just to hit a quota.
What happens if my entry never fills?+
If price never reaches your entry within 5 hours, the signal automatically expires and is cancelled. Expired signals are never counted as wins or losses in the stats.
Why only one take-profit instead of TP1/TP2/TP3?+
A single fixed target removes the temptation to second-guess, move stops emotionally, or chase a "better" exit mid-trade. One entry, one stop, one target — the same discipline, every single time.
What's the difference between free and premium?+
Free members see full bot performance — stats, win rate, Fear & Greed Index, and history — plus the pair name on every signal. Premium unlocks the actual entry price, stop loss, take profit, risk:reward ratio, and dynamic leverage needed to execute the trade.
Which exchange do I need?+
Signals are based on futures pricing and are easiest to execute on Binance Futures, though the entry/SL/TP levels can be applied on any exchange offering the same pairs.
